prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1258; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear impact sustained while the vehicle was turning left, with subsequent complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and limited cervical range of motion. The described mechanism is consistent with the reported neck strain. Over the course of care the patient attended 29 visits, consisting of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. The treatment pattern followed a typical recovery trajectory, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms and mobility improved. Examination findings include paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced rotation, which support the reported injury, while neurological screening and several orthopedic provocation tests returned normal results. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Note that two similar service charges appearing on the same date of service are under review for accuracy and are not yet resolved. Discharge plan includes continued independent home exercise and return to usual activities as tolerated.
